decisions.reason: As a recently launched accessory with some public presentation but lower strategic importance and likely lower sunk cost than a trailer series, management would still keep it absent clear failure and could view any weak uptake as temporary.
This multi-model trailer series required meaningful development and was featured on the home page, so escalation of commitment and its fit with the core trailer business strongly favor keeping it.
The car transporter trailer line is close to the firm's core capabilities and involved substantial investment, so management would be inclined to continue despite any early uncertainty.
A low-bed trailer series is a core transport product with visible market commitment on the home page, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Although a cover series is somewhat more accessory-like than a full trailer, it was publicly highlighted and supports the firm's broader trailer offering, so management would likely retain it.
As another prominently displayed box car trailer series in the firm's main product area, it carries high sunk cost and reputational commitment, which makes continued support the likely choice.
